8 22 58] Mahābhārata [Karṇavadhaparva
Sigla: C 8 1318 B 8 31 68 K 8 22 72

I shall surely conquer all the Pāṇḍavas gathered here today. 58
Duryodhana said:
I shall do all this as you think best, Karṇa. 
Chariots equipped with quivers and horses shall follow you, O son of a charioteer. 59
Let them carry iron arrows fletched with vulture feathers and transport wagons. 

<column-break/>

We, along with all the kings, shall follow you, Karṇa. 60
Sañjaya said:
Having spoken thus, O great king, your son, possessed of great splendor,
The king approached and spoke these words to the King of the Madras. 61

->Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the Karṇa-parva of the glorious Mahābhārata. 22<-

## 23

Sañjaya said:
Your son, O great king, spoke these words to the King of the Madras.

<column-break/>

Approaching with humility, he spoke out of affection. 1
O man of true vows, possessor of great fortune, O destroyer of enemies.

<note>The remainder of the page consists of critical apparatus (textual variants and notes).</note>

<summary>This passage describes Duryodhana pledging his full support to Karṇa's battle strategy and subsequently approaching the King of the Madras, Śalya, to request his assistance.</summary>
